messages:
harper: Quick sync  propose a small pilot for SI co-sell handoffs when deals touch marketplace listings + certified HW. Goal: reduce churn and make ownership auditable.

josh: Sounds good. what's the pilot?

meera: Idea: introduce a partner_priority_score (0-100) computed from: certification_level, rebate_commitment, POC_funding, and earliest_registration_ts. If score >= 70 -> auto-handoff to SI; 50-69 -> Partnership review; <50 -> AE. Will let telemetry tune thresholds.

tomas: Love quantifying it. Need to ensure legal/PS engagement triggers when auto-handoff happens. Maybe require "handoff_audit_log" entry and a quick ops ack.

harper: Agreed. also add a conservative marketplace rule: marketplace_optin must be explicit for pilot. i.e., no implicit transfers.

adrian: Small implementation snippet for intake validation we can paste into Confluence:

```
# compute partner_priority_score (example weights)
score = 10*cert_level + 25*(poc_cost_share >= 0.5) + 20*(rebate_commit) + 30*(registered_first)
if marketplace_optin == True and score >= 70:
  owner = 'SI'
elif score >= 50:
  owner = 'Partnerships:Review'
elif ARR >= 250000:
  owner = 'SI'  # ARR override
else:
  owner = 'AE'
```

meera: For auditability: intake must include registration_token, rebate_owner, rebate_estimate_usd, demo_owner, and a checkbox "handoff_recorded_to_audit_log". Auto-handoff should post to #partners-ops and create a short ticket for Partnerships to ACK.

josh: Edge case: multi-SI. If two partners have same score and registered within 1h, require tie-break: first to accept within 12h wins, else Ownership -> AE. Add partner_ack_ts field.

adrian: Co-announcement timing: SI asks 9 business days. Marketing prefers 12. Proposal: pilot default 10bd, with an expedite checkbox that requires explicit marketing+legal sign-off. Capture announce_timing_days in intake.

tomas: Telemetry plan: track auto-handoff precision (how many result in partner-led closes vs rollbacks), marketplace_optin opt-in rate, intake SLA misses. We'll run pilot for 6 weeks and evaluate.

harper: Action items: 1) Meera: add partner_priority_score logic + intake fields PR. 2) Josh: wire Slack post + create ack ticket flow for auto-hand-offs. 3) Adrian: add announce timing + marketing signoff checklist. 4) Tomas: telemetry dashboard for pilot.

partners-bot: New task created: PART-5102 "Partner priority pilot: intake + auto-handoff + telemetry" assigned to meera, josh, adrian, tomas, due in 6 weeks. Link: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/PART-5102 :robot_face:

meera: I'll open the PR with example CSV for SKUs and a small demo of priority score calculation. tagging @josh @adrian @tomas.

josh: thumbs up. we'll keep marketplace_optin manual for pilot. after 6 weeks we'll look at metrics and decide whether to expand.

adrian: Noted. i'll prep marketing + legal checklist items and the expedite signoff flow.

tomas: I'll sketch a dashboard with precision/recall style metrics for auto-handoff quality.

harper: Recap for doc in one line: Meera (priority logic + PR), Josh (ack workflow + Slack), Adrian (announce checklist), Tomas (telemetry & dashboard). :white_check_mark:

harper: Thanks team 64f. This should make handoffs less noisy and give us data to move from manual to automated.
